title: ICJ orders Israel to report on provisional measures
summary: The reporting direction forms part of the Court’s interim order and does not decide the merits.
claim: The Court ordered Israel to submit a report within one month on all measures taken to give effect to the provisional-measures order.
legal_characterization: Binding procedural component of an ICJ provisional-measures order; no final merits determination.
source_title: Order of 26 January 2024, Application of the Genocide Convention in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel)
verification_notes: Verified against the operative clause. This is a reporting requirement at the provisional-measures stage, not a merits judgment.
